name: How long does it take to see results from AEO implementation?
description: Initial AEO results can appear in weeks to months. Achieving broad and consistent visibility typically requires 6-12 months of sustained effort.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO implementation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from AEO implementation can vary. Initial improvements in visibility, such as appearing in some featured snippets, might be observed within a few weeks to a few months, especially for highly targeted and well-optimized content. However, consistently capturing top positions for a wide range of queries and building substantial authority often requires a sustained effort over 6-12 months. Factors like the competitiveness of your industry, the quality and volume of your content, and the technical health of your website all influence how quickly results manifest.
